data: In the top plot, which line has a higher value in the y-axis after 25000 iterations?

The question asks about the line with a higher value in the y-axis after 25000 iterations in the top plot. The top plot is labeled "Visual Loss," and there are two lines in this plot: one blue line and one red line. The blue line represents the Aggregated Loss, and the red line represents the Stochastic Loss. 

From the analysis of the figure, the blue line (Aggregated Loss) appears to have a higher value than the red line (Stochastic Loss) after 25000 iterations. This can be verified by observing the position of the two lines at the 25000 mark on the x-axis. The blue line is consistently above the red line throughout the entire range of the x-axis. Therefore, the answer is the blue line.
